from rich.markdown import CodeBlock
from rich.console import Console
import io

def test_code_block_trailing_newline():
    console_file = io.StringIO()
    console = Console(file=console_file, width=100, color_system=None)
    
    cb = CodeBlock('text', 'theme')

    console.print(cb)
    output1 = console_file.getvalue()

    console2.print(cb2)
    output2 = console_file2.getvalue()
    
    print(f"With newline: {repr(output1)}")
    print(f"Without newline: {repr(output2)}")
    print(f"Equal: {output1 == output2}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_code_block_trailing_newline()
